commands.output_excerpt: THE MEASUREMENT THAT PROVES THE FIX: 'forwards ordinary Say chat' now runs in 1ms. Before FND-007 the same test took 1488ms on a WARM box against 0-5ms for every neighbour in the same file. The 300-1000x outlier is gone, which confirms the cost was import-bound exactly as diagnosed.
535 passed (535) across 51 files - count unchanged, so removing 11 dynamic imports did not drop or skip any test.

known_risks: A STATIC import was chosen over the recommended beforeAll. Justification checked rather than assumed: the file contains ZERO vi.mock / vi.doMock / vi.resetModules / vi.unmock, so nothing depends on lazy module loading, and it already statically imports ../routes/auth.js and ../routes/mods.js. A collection-time import is gated by NO timeout at all, whereas a beforeAll still runs under hookTimeout. The investigating agent named both options; this is the stronger one.

discordBot.js is now loaded whenever any test in bugfixes.test.js runs, including a filtered run targeting an unrelated describe block. Cost is paid at collection, outside any timeout, and the whole-file run got faster, so this is accepted.

The comment above the new import states why it must not be moved back inline. Without it, a future reader sees an ordinary import and could 'tidy' it into the helper that needs it, silently restoring RISK-001.
